2025-09-28
Claim opened atfer the policyholder reported a collision at an intersection while turning left, with the claimant's vehicle
reportedly struck on its driver side. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer and reported neck and back strain.
2025-10-13
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy and that coverage was in force
at the time of the reported loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
2025-10-19
Spoke with the claimant, who described the same sequence of events as in the first report, with the other vehicle
turning across their path. Responding officer's report and statements from the scene confirm the claimant was in the
vehicle at the time.
2025-11-04
Photos submitted with the claim show damage that matches the described impact. Some details are visible in the
images, though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
2025-12-01
Requested prior claim and vehicle history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and no piror injury to the neck
or back has been identified in the records received so far.
2025-12-02
Medical records show treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of strain. It is not yet clear
whether the injury came from this crash, and the treating provider's causation opinion is still pending.
2026-01-17
File remains open pending receipt of the complete medical records and the causation opinion. Next step is to
schedule a follow-up call with the claimant to confirm treatment details and any further documentation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
